claims.claim_scope: Week 6 external split with the final gated system
limitations: The zero false-answer result coexists with 23/50 false refusals.
Citation validity is structural rather than a complete human semantic-support audit.

presentation.claim_scope: 第六周外部 50 条样本，最终门禁系统
presentation.label: 失败关闭式回答安全
limitations: 错误回答为零的同时存在 23/50 次错误拒答。
引用有效性只做了结构校验，不等同于完整的人工语义支持审计。
presentation.meaning: 这意味着系统宁可拒答，也不会在证据不足时编造答案。
presentation.summary: 在外部样本范围内得到验证：失败关闭门禁使错误回答为 0/50，代价是 23/50 次错误拒答。

claims.public_summary: Demonstrated within the 50-case external scope: fail-closed gating produced 0/50 false answers, with a disclosed 23/50 false-refusal cost.

limitations: The reranked hybrid variant did not improve on plain hybrid RRF.

presentation.claim_scope: 第六周外部 50 条检索消融样本
presentation.label: 混合检索提升
limitations: 加入重排后没有超过基础混合 RRF。
presentation.meaning: 这意味着关键词与向量检索互补，能找到更多相关文档。
presentation.summary: 在外部检索样本中得到验证：混合 RRF 将文档命中率从 30/50 提升到 40/50。

claims.public_summary: Demonstrated within the external retrieval split: hybrid RRF increased document hit@5 from 30/50 to 40/50.

presentation.question: 证据门禁能否让检索增强回答更安全？

questions.question: Can evidence gates make retrieval-augmented answers safer?

limitations: The run was diagnostic and not headline eligible.
Rule and LLM controllers produced the same outcome rate.

presentation.claim_scope: 22 条混合智能体残差诊断样本
presentation.label: 智能体恢复收益
limitations: 该运行仅用于诊断，不具备主结论资格。
规则控制器与模型控制器的结果率相同。
presentation.meaning: 这意味着增加智能体循环并不自动带来可靠性收益。
presentation.summary: 在混合诊断范围内未得到验证：模型控制器成功 6/22，门禁系统成功 5/22，而且规则与模型控制器结果相同，不能证明智能体恢复的独立价值。

claims.public_summary: Not demonstrated in the mixed diagnostic scope: the one-case improvement was shared by rule and LLM controllers and did not establish agentic recovery value.

presentation.question: 有界恢复循环能否带来可测量价值？

questions.question: Does a bounded agentic recovery loop add measurable value?

limitations: Safety did not imply useful action selection; the Q3 anti-gaming triad failed.

presentation.label: 受治理动作安全

presentation.meaning: 这意味着提案即使看似合理，也不能绕过证据和权限门禁。
presentation.summary: 在运维开发范围内得到验证：9/9 次未授权尝试全部被阻断，无证据动作与未授权漏升级均为零。

claims.public_summary: Demonstrated within the Q3 ops scope: all 9 unauthorized attempts were blocked and F11/F13 remained zero.

limitations: This negative Q3 result was later superseded by the disclosed Q4 frozen-ops_test second-run result.

presentation.label: 动作选择有效性
limitations: 该负结果后来由已披露的 Q4 冻结 ops_test 第二次运行结果接替。
presentation.meaning: 这意味着只会拦截危险动作还不够，系统也要减少不必要的人工升级。
presentation.summary: 在运维开发范围内被否定：安全动作仍存在过度升级，规则系统授权精确率为 15/33，有效性三联门未通过。

claims.public_summary: Falsified in the Q3 ops scope: safe actions were still over-escalated, and the anti-gaming usefulness triad failed.

presentation.question: 信任门禁能否治理具有副作用的动作？

questions.question: Can trust gates govern side-effecting actions?

claims.claim_scope: Q4 frozen ops_test second-run mechanism verification
limitations: The result is real but thin and clears the precision floor by roughly one case-equivalent.
The ops_test split was run twice; the first failure and the intervening mechanism correction are both archived.
The split uses new queries over the same small synthetic corpus, and five queries were repaired after the logic freeze; this is not pristine novel-corpus generalization.
The LLM controller did not pass the triad.

presentation.claim_scope: 冻结 ops_test 的第二次机制复验
presentation.frozen_scope: 冻结 ops_test 第二次运行
presentation.label: 冻结评测集上的校准动作选择
limitations: 该结果来自真实运行，但样本仍薄，授权精确率仅以约一个案例的余量越过门槛。
ops_test 共运行两次；首次失败与其后的机制修正均已归档披露。
该 split 使用同一小型合成语料上的新查询，且逻辑冻结后修复过五条查询；它不是全新语料上的一次性独立泛化证明。
模型控制器未通过有效性三联门。
presentation.meaning: 这意味着校准让系统在维持安全底线的同时，减少了错误升级。
presentation.summary: 在已披露的冻结 ops_test 第二次运行中得到验证：校准后的规则控制器授权精确率达到 33/51，并通过有效性三联门。

claims.public_summary: Demonstrated in the disclosed second run over frozen ops_test: the calibrated rule controller reached 33/51 authorized precision and passed the anti-gaming triad.

claims.claim_scope: Q4 frozen ops_test second-run safety floor
limitations: The ops_test split was run twice; this safety result is scoped to the disclosed frozen second run, not a pristine one-shot holdout.
The corpus is synthetic and controlled; real execution does not mean production traffic or customer data.
The stable product release remains v3.0-q4-reliability; Q5 does not supersede it.

presentation.claim_scope: 冻结 ops_test 第二次运行的安全底线
presentation.frozen_scope: 冻结 ops_test 第二次运行
presentation.label: 冻结评测集上的治理安全底线
limitations: ops_test 共运行两次；该安全结果只适用于已披露的冻结第二次运行，不是一次性 pristine holdout。

稳定产品版本仍为既有可靠性版本；后续研究不取代该版本。
presentation.meaning: 这意味着改善动作选择没有削弱原有安全门。
presentation.summary: 在已披露的冻结 ops_test 第二次运行中得到验证：9/9 次未授权动作全部被阻断，无证据动作与未授权漏升级保持为零。

claims.public_summary: Demonstrated in the disclosed second run over frozen ops_test: unauthorized actions remained blocked and F11/F13 stayed at zero.
